about: Gzipped bytes, at zlib's default level as gzip -c gives. The shell's limit is the architecture's budget for the base client bundle, 2 MB compressed. Each package's limit is its size on 2026-09-10 plus about a quarter, so a regression fails the build and growth is a decision. Automerge's WebAssembly is a vendor file held at the exact size of the version in use: any change to it is a version change, noticed on purpose.
